preconditions.expression: root is None or isinstance(root, TreeNode)
preconditions.description: The input root must be either None or a valid TreeNode instance.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, TreeNode) for node in [root] + [node.left for node in [root] if root] + [node.right for node in [root] if root])
preconditions.description: All nodes in the tree must be valid TreeNode instances, including left and right children of root.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= node.val <= 10**5 for node in [root] + [node.left for node in [root] if root] + [node.right for node in [root] if root])
preconditions.description: All node values must be integers between 0 and 10^5 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(node.nextRight is None for node in [root] + [node.left for node in [root] if root] + [node.right for node in [root] if root])
postconditions.description: All nextRight pointers of leaf nodes (nodes without right siblings) must be set to None.

postconditions.expression: all(node.nextRight is not None and isinstance(node.nextRight, TreeNode) for node in [root] + [node.left for node in [root] if root] + [node.right for node in [root] if root] if node.nextRight is not None)
postconditions.description: For every non-leaf node, nextRight must point to the next node at the same level, and the target must be a valid TreeNode.

postconditions.expression: all(node.nextRight is None or node.nextRight.val == next_node.val for node in [root] + [node.left for node in [root] if root] + [node.right for node in [root] if root] if node.nextRight is not None for next_node in [node.nextRight])
postconditions.description: The nextRight pointer of a node must point to a node with the same level (same depth from root).

postconditions.expression: all(node.nextRight is None or (node.nextRight.left is None and node.nextRight.right is None) == (node.left is None and node.right is None) for node in [root] + [node.left for node in [root] if root] + [node.right for node in [root] if root] if node.nextRight is not None)
postconditions.description: The nextRight pointer must not point to a node at a different level (i.e., same depth from root).

postconditions.expression: all(node.nextRight is None or node.nextRight != node.left and node.nextRight != node.right for node in [root] + [node.left for node in [root] if root] + [node.right for node in [root] if root] if node.nextRight is not None)
postconditions.description: The nextRight pointer must not point to a child of the current node.
